title: BookStack before 26.09.2 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the ZIP content importer that…
description: BookStack versions before 26.09.2 have a vulnerability in the ZIP content importer that allows authenticated users with Import Content permission to cause uncontrolled resource consumption. By uploading a crafted ZIP file where data.json references a single bundled file multiple times, the importer writes multiple full copies of that file, exhausting server storage.
